leverage.basis: Gross contractual debt including securitization and finance leases / issuer net-income-based EBITDA; consolidated cash fully netted; not covenant leverage. Annual pages 71, 120, 144–145.

net_leverage.basis: Gross contractual debt including securitization and finance leases / issuer net-income-based EBITDA; consolidated cash fully netted; not covenant leverage. Annual pages 71, 120, 144–145.

coverage.basis: Issuer EBITDA / cash paid for interest, net; net of interest income, not gross cash interest or legal fixed-charge coverage. Annual pages 71, 123.

cash.basis: Cash is consolidated reported cash; facilities cell is disclosed revolving availability only. Excludes 163 of conditional receivables capacity and excludes subsequent dividend payment. Annual pages 55, 120, 152.

undrawn.basis: Cash is consolidated reported cash; facilities cell is disclosed revolving availability only. Excludes 163 of conditional receivables capacity and excludes subsequent dividend payment. Annual pages 55, 120, 152.
